Name: Kunkun FishBite Core
Author: Dingtrue114
Description:
Description Kunkun FishBite Core is a powerful and lightweight framework for Stardew Valley designed to replace or enhance the original fishing bite sound effect. It provides a modular environment for players to customize their fishing experience by using their own custom .wav sound files.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI (Stardew Modding API).[/*]
[*]Download and unzip the Kunkun FishBite Core mod folder.[/*]
[*]Move the mod folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" directory.[/*]
[*]Place your custom .wav audio files into the "assets/sounds" folder inside the mod directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[*](Optional) Use the Generic Mod Config Menu to select your preferred audio file and configure settings.[/*]
[*]If you add new sounds while the game is running, open the SMAPI console and type "kunkun_reload" to refresh the sound library.[/*]
[/list]Main features
[list]
[*]Custom Sound Support: Easily import your own .wav files to replace the standard bite sound.[/*]
[*]Multiple Playback Modes: Choose between Random (plays a random sound from your folder), Sequential (plays sounds in order), or Specific (plays only your chosen sound).[/*]
[*]Fully Configurable: Adjust trigger chance, volume, delay, and enable/disable original game sounds directly via the game menu.[/*]
[*]Hotkey Support: Configure custom keybinds for toggling the mod, cycling through playback modes, and reloading the sound library.[/*]
[*]Notification System: Receive optional, clean in-game HUD messages when mod settings or modes are changed.[/*]
[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI: Required to run this mod.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (Recommended): Highly recommended to easily customize settings, volume, and sound selection within the game.[/*]
[/list]Shout outs
[list]
[*]A special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for the inspiration and the developers of the Generic Mod Config Menu for making configuration accessible and user-friendly.[/*]
[/list]模组描述 Kunkun FishBite Core 是一款为《星露谷物语》打造的强大且轻量的钓鱼咬钩音效框架。它提供了一个模块化的环境，让玩家可以通过导入自定义的 .wav 音频文件来替换或增强游戏原版的钓鱼咬钩音效，打造个性化的钓鱼体验。
安装指南 
[list=1]
[*]安装最新版本的 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]下载并解压模组文件夹。[/*]
[*]将模组文件夹放入《星露谷物语》的 "Mods" 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]将你想要使用的自定义 .wav 音频文件放入模组文件夹下的 "assets/sounds" 目录中。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[*](可选) 推荐安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 以便在游戏中选择音频文件并调整各项设置。[/*]
[*]如果在游戏运行期间添加了新的音频文件，请在 SMAPI 控制台输入 "kunkun_reload" 来刷新音效库。[/*]
[/list]主要功能
[list]
[*]自定义音效支持：轻松导入你的 .wav 文件来替换原版咬钩音效。[/*]
[*]多种播放模式：支持随机播放、顺序播放或指定播放特定音效。[/*]
[*]高度可配置：通过游戏内的菜单即可调整触发概率、音量、延迟以及是否静音原版音效。[/*]
[*]快捷键支持：支持自定义按键来开关模组、切换播放模式以及重载音效库。[/*]
[*]状态提示：设置变更时，游戏内会显示清晰的 HUD 提示信息。[/*]
[/list]依赖需求
[list]
[*]SMAPI：运行本模组的基础环境。[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (推荐)：强烈建议安装，以便在游戏内便捷地调整模组参数。[/*]
[/list]致谢 
[list]
[*]感谢《星露谷物语》模组社区提供的灵感，以及 Generic Mod Config Menu 的开发者们，让配置模组变得如此简单直观。[/*]
[/list]
